summary: Our project focuses on NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. We developed an educational storytelling project to raise awareness about the spacecraft, rovers, and other equipment left behind during space exploration missions. Through creative storytelling and visual presentations, we explain why this equipment was abandoned, its purpose, and how it contributes to scientific discoveries. This project addresses the challenge by helping people understand that these objects are not simply forgotten waste but important parts of human space exploration history. It is important because it encourages people to appreciate past achievements, understand the impact of space exploration on the environment, and think about the importance of responsible space exploration in the future.
details: Our project, "Abandoned but Not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars," is an educational storytelling project that explains the history and importance of equipment left behind during space exploration missions. How does it work? Our project uses storytelling, pictures, illustrations and interesting facts to introduce abandoned space equipment. It explains what each object was used for, why it was left behind and how it contributed to space exploration. Benefits and Intended Impact This project helps people learn more about NASA's missions and understand that abandoned equipment is part of human scientific history. It also raises awareness about responsible space exploration and encourages curiosity about space science. Tools and Software We use research materials, NASA information, PowerPoint and digital illustrations to develop our presentation. No special hardware or coding languages are required. Creativity Our creative approach is to give abandoned equipment a voice by telling its story from its own perspective. This makes scientific information more interesting, memorable and easier to understand. Factors Considered Our team considered scientific accuracy, creativity, educational value, environmental awareness and the importance of presenting information in a simple and engaging way.
